audit.whatIsWrong: Gwen's R is written 'Needle Work' in four places (it is Needlework), and it is repeatedly called an execute.
audit.why: Riot's text for Needlework: it hurls a needle that slows, deals magic damage and applies A Thousand Cuts, castable up to two more times. There is no execute and no health threshold — telling a player they get executed changes when they choose to fight. A Thousand Cuts is the real sustain engine (she heals off the damage it deals to champions), which is why anti-heal matters. Hallowed Mist is a zone: only enemies who enter it can target her — 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Name it Needlework, describe it as a three-cast slow, and put the healing on A Thousand Cuts where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-2 read Skill while their own whys say Vayne owns them; row 6 reads Vayne while its why says the late game is even.
audit.why: whys[0] 'Vayne pokes freely... while Gwen must walk up to melee-farm', whys[1] 'keeps chipping Gwen at Level 2', whys[2] 'still controls Level 3', whys[6] 'Late it's even skill'. The packet chart agrees: Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Gwen, Gwen, Skill. The enums were the only layer disagreeing.
audit.corrected: Chart: Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Gwen, Gwen, Skill, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes had no cooldown numbers on the two abilities that define the stages.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Skip 'n Slash 13s falling to 11s with a partial refund on hit, Snip Snip! 6.5s falling to 3.5s, Needlework 120/100/80s. The Mist window is what decides whether her level-6 spike lands.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[1], dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.why: report[8] already buys Executioner's Calling early and breakdown.late already says anti-heal stays core — correct against A Thousand Cuts. Skip 'n Slash applying on-hit means her damage scales with attack speed, so armour alone misreads the trade; that is now stated in the first-item spike.
audit.corrected: No item edit; the anti-heal reasoning is corrected in spikes[2].

edits.before: At Level 6 Needle Work plus Hallowed Mist make Gwen untargetable and let her all-in through Vayne's kite.
edits.after: At Level 6 Needlework plus a 22s Hallowed Mist let Gwen all-in through Vayne's kite from safety.

edits.before: Gwen's Mist, sustain, and R execute out-scale Vayne's early lead once her items come online.
edits.after: Gwen's Mist, A Thousand Cuts healing, and item scaling out-pace Vayne's early lead here.

edits.before: Gwen's power flips here. Needle Work (R) plus Hallowed Mist (W) makes her untargetable to your ranged autos and lets her all-in through your kite, and her passive %-health true damage shreds you. Respect the W bubble — don't dive in, and save Condemn for her E engage.
edits.after: Gwen's power flips here. Needlework (R) has three casts and Hallowed Mist (W) means only enemies inside it can target her, so she all-ins from safety while A Thousand Cuts heals her off you. Stay out of the 22s bubble and hold Condemn for her Skip 'n Slash.

edits.before: Gwen out-scales your early lead once she has Nashor's/Riftmaker online: her Mist negates your autos, her sustain out-heals your poke, and her R execute finishes you. Play safe, farm, and avoid extended fights inside her Mist.
edits.after: Gwen out-scales your early lead once Nashor's/Riftmaker land: Mist blocks your autos from outside, and A Thousand Cuts heals her off every hit — Needlework only slows, it does not execute. Buy anti-heal and refuse long fights.

edits.before: Levels 3-4 stay yours as you keep punishing her walk-ups and Condemn her Skip 'n Slash engages, but at Levels 5-6 it flips hard: Hallowed Mist (W) plus Needle Work (R) make her untargetable and let her all-in through your kite with %-health true damage.
edits.after: Levels 3-4 stay yours as you keep punishing her walk-ups and Condemn her Skip 'n Slash engages, but at Levels 5-6 it flips hard: Hallowed Mist (W) plus Needlework (R) let her all-in from inside the bubble with %-health true damage you cannot answer.

edits.before: Execute you with Needle Work (R) plus passive %-health true damage
edits.after: Chip you with Needlework (R) plus her A Thousand Cuts healing

edits.before: Gwen wastes Hallowed Mist — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 — that gap is your only all-in.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash is 11-13s but refunds part of it if she hits you.

notes: Two real defects the packet only half-caught: Gwen's R is Needlework (written 'Needle Work' in four strings), and it was described as an execute in two places — Riot's text has no threshold, it is a three-cast slow. The sustain that actually decides the lane is A Thousand Cuts, now named. Level chart rows 0-2 and 6 contradicted their own whys and the packet; flipped as matched pairs. The full layer calls Vayne 'he/him' throughout tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.feeding and report[3] — same global template issue the mirror agent flagged, not fixable per-file within the length band.
